1. **F1 — blocking, issue-impact, high:** A nested put is not durable before the redo record is removed. [`create_dir_all`](crates/jit/src/storage/redo_apply.rs:171) creates missing ancestors, but the code syncs only the deepest directory after the rename. A crash can therefore retain record removal while losing an ancestor directory entry (and its nested file), leaving no redo record to replay. Sync each newly created parent entry before record removal, and cover fresh nested paths in recovery testing. References: `@/charter/D-17`, `@/invariant/derived-state-coherence`.
